summary: Example version 3 definition: build_arg_defaults, dependencies (galaxy, python, system), images.base_image, options.package_manager_path and additional_build_steps such as prepend_galaxy ENV settings for the automation hub server and token.
questions: How do I pass the automation hub token to ansible-builder?
How do I set package_manager_path to microdnf?
Which base image is supported by Red Hat?

answer_card.title: execution-environment.yml (version 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
version: 3
dependencies:
  galaxy: requirements.yml
  python:
    - six
  system: bindep.txt
images:
  base_image:
    name: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ee-minimal-rhel9:latest
options:
  package_manager_path: /usr/bin/microdnf
additional_build_steps:
  prepend_galaxy:
    - ENV ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_LIST=automation_hub
    - ENV ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_AUTOMATION_HUB_URL=https://console.redhat.com/api/automation-hub/content/published/
    - ARG ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_AUTOMATION_HUB_TOKEN
```
Pass `--build-arg ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_AUTOMATION_HUB_TOKEN` when building.
